f0e252c4558f3f9e0e89e3c908ca146e2a9123aa.source: (1) All citizens shall have the right—
f0e252c4558f3f9e0e89e3c908ca146e2a9123aa.gloss: Every citizen has the right to the following freedoms (each is subject to the restrictions set out in the later clauses):

37117c97adf2172f75ae0b063ab3b6492e4fae91.source: (a) to freedom of speech and expression;
37117c97adf2172f75ae0b063ab3b6492e4fae91.gloss: to speak and express yourself freely;

fdee692795c77611c516ce7893918a4cc72795cc.source: (b) to assemble peaceably and without arms;

f2f00e60f65115ef1b52e083ad8077b6f90d417c.source: (c) to form associations or unions [or co-operative societies];
f2f00e60f65115ef1b52e083ad8077b6f90d417c.gloss: to form associations or unions (or co-operative societies);

386f8d27bba4adbc139252f51a64e4d51606c9b5.source: (d) to move freely throughout the territory of India;
386f8d27bba4adbc139252f51a64e4d51606c9b5.gloss: to move freely throughout the territory of India;

41bd726ba63c5b9d771445501764567ebfef7fd7.source: (e) to reside and settle in any part of the territory of India; [and] [(f)* * * * *
41bd726ba63c5b9d771445501764567ebfef7fd7.gloss: to live and settle in any part of the territory of India;

de0a83d821d6837d231a027a002113fddf6ce43a.source: (g) to practise any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade or business.
de0a83d821d6837d231a027a002113fddf6ce43a.gloss: to practise any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade or business (this right is subject to the restrictions in clause (6), which is not explained here).

494d49d4a4ab8050d32ebcbcbeb007653a9b577e.source: (2) Nothing in sub-clause (a) of clause (1) shall affect the operation of any existing law, or prevent the State from making any law, in so far as such law imposes reasonable restrictions on the exercise of the right conferred by the said sub-clause in the interests of [the sovereignty and integrity of India], the security of the State, friendly relations with foreign States, public order, decency or morality, or in relation to contempt of court, defamation or incitement to an offence.
494d49d4a4ab8050d32ebcbcbeb007653a9b577e.gloss: The right in sub-clause (a) does not affect any existing law, and does not stop the State from making a law, to the extent that law imposes reasonable restrictions on free speech and expression in the interests of the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security of the State, friendly relations with foreign States, public order, decency or morality, or in relation to contempt of court, defamation or incitement to an offence.

aef537f1fae3a3e206d0e612766e1854a7be1c0c.source: (3) Nothing in sub-clause (b) of the said clause shall affect the operation of any existing law in so far as it imposes, or prevent the State from making any law imposing, in the interests of [the sovereignty and integrity of India or] public order, reasonable restrictions on the exercise of the right conferred by the said sub-clause.
aef537f1fae3a3e206d0e612766e1854a7be1c0c.gloss: The right in sub-clause (b) does not affect any existing law, and does not stop the State from making a law, that imposes reasonable restrictions on the right to assemble peaceably, in the interests of the sovereignty and integrity of India or public order.

ac110039e12da8deb78cc48f5a4f16c0914d1097.source: (4) Nothing in sub-clause (c) of the said clause shall affect the operation of any existing law in so far as it imposes, or prevent the State from making any law imposing, in the interests of [the sovereignty and integrity of India or] public order or morality, reasonable restrictions on the exercise of the right conferred by the said sub-clause.
ac110039e12da8deb78cc48f5a4f16c0914d1097.gloss: The right in sub-clause (c) does not affect any existing law, and does not stop the State from making a law, that imposes reasonable restrictions on the right to form associations or unions, in the interests of the sovereignty and integrity of India or public order or morality.

b6d901834dd67189143eb5ab8d58065cbba082a2.source: (5) Nothing in [sub-clauses (d) and (e)] of the said clause shall affect the operation of any existing law in so far as it imposes, or prevent the State from making any law imposing, reasonable restrictions on the exercise of any of the rights conferred by the said sub-clauses either in the interests of the general public or for the protection of the interests of any Scheduled Tribe.
b6d901834dd67189143eb5ab8d58065cbba082a2.gloss: The rights in sub-clauses (d) and (e) do not affect any existing law, and do not stop the State from making a law, that imposes reasonable restrictions on those rights, either in the interests of the general public or for the protection of the interests of any Scheduled Tribe.

14c8d6d6f8f3624aa7081b5d1420fdce18d20270.source: It shall be the duty of every citizen of India—
14c8d6d6f8f3624aa7081b5d1420fdce18d20270.gloss: It is the duty of every citizen of India:

adb2c987d4f5a5f30e618eb50cb62e5c54349df5.source: (a) to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem;
adb2c987d4f5a5f30e618eb50cb62e5c54349df5.gloss: to follow the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem;

2428010581776b1bc581ae9284a85167645145aa.source: (b) to cherish and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom;
2428010581776b1bc581ae9284a85167645145aa.gloss: to value and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom;

423ee606015c6f8c7e4484ee65afc4892b8a1175.source: (c) to uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India;
423ee606015c6f8c7e4484ee65afc4892b8a1175.gloss: to uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India;

7389fe0520e098997fa44915afbbf2e0e7af91c3.source: (d) to defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so;
7389fe0520e098997fa44915afbbf2e0e7af91c3.gloss: to defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so;

eb76d381f821ab56753f97364982c2d2b27ba174.source: (e) to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India transcending religious, linguistic and regional or sectional diversities; to renounce practices derogatory to the dignity of women;
eb76d381f821ab56753f97364982c2d2b27ba174.gloss: to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood among all the people of India, going beyond religious, linguistic and regional or sectional differences; and to give up practices that are derogatory to the dignity of women;

2edfc49820d67b4f8a5e6e4eaed4ad201d2d9900.source: (f) to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture;
2edfc49820d67b4f8a5e6e4eaed4ad201d2d9900.gloss: to value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture;

233a0ae24f569914d47ee00ec3547bd3849727c9.source: (g) to protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers and wild life, and to have compassion for living creatures;
233a0ae24f569914d47ee00ec3547bd3849727c9.gloss: to protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers and wild life, and to have compassion for living creatures;

b128abcee425654387f514d6364babf93d49f1c4.source: (h) to develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform;
b128abcee425654387f514d6364babf93d49f1c4.gloss: to develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform;

7dbfc61d809c822fcbd27a2115758cfb8771f90b.source: (i) to safeguard public property and to abjure violence;
7dbfc61d809c822fcbd27a2115758cfb8771f90b.gloss: to protect public property and to give up violence;

397bdf90feeea5015c5d1d0d71e67eb1c1450aa7.source: (j) to strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavour and achievement;
397bdf90feeea5015c5d1d0d71e67eb1c1450aa7.gloss: to strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity, so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavour and achievement;

394cdac124e573e2feb2b5ae8e65c29fe62f4195.source: (k) who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years.
394cdac124e573e2feb2b5ae8e65c29fe62f4195.gloss: for a citizen who is a parent or guardian, to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years.
